### Running the Race
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-may-28-2025.html
Passage: Philippians 3:13-14
Points:
- Constantly glancing backward breaks a runner's stride and hinders spiritual progress.
- Forgetting the past means refusing to let previous sins and mistakes dictate present life.
- Because God has already forgiven our past failures, we must not dwell on lingering guilt.
- Past spiritual successes can tempt believers to become complacent instead of persevering.
- Disciples must keep their eyes on God's call until they cross the finish line.

### Pressing Forward
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/pressing-forward
Passage: Philippians 3:12-14
Points:
- Assurance of final glorification does not excuse passivity in Christian living.
- Paul recognized he had not yet reached completion and needed to keep pressing forward.
- Trusting God to complete salvation motivates believers to know Christ more fully.
- Believers must heed the Holy Spirit's guidance through Scripture to stay active in faith.
- Christians should pursue their eternal prize with undivided attention, brushing aside distractions.
